name: interchangeable
rule: Interchanging the arguments must preserve the answer.
declaration: contract interchangeable(a: I64 in -5..=18, b: I64 in -5..=18) { transition(a,b) == transition(b,a) }
limitation: Symmetry alone does not determine which pairs should be accepted.

name: makes_ten
rule: Accept exactly when an argument is ten or the sum is ten.
declaration: contract makes_ten(a: I64 in -5..=18, b: I64 in -5..=18) { transition(a,b) == (min(a,b) == 10 || max(a,b) == 10 || a+b == 10) }
limitation: Both arguments are restricted to signed integers from -5 through 18.
